# USA Poodle

> AKC red toy poodle breeder in Ventura, California. Home-raised red toy poodle puppies, serving Southern California.

Phone: (805) 888-0133
Email: socalhass@gmail.com
Website: https://usapoodle.com/

## Key facts
- Breed/color: Toy Poodles, deep red
- Every litter AKC registered; AKC registration and lifetime microchip registration prepaid
- Available now: Claude, red male, born Aug 12, 2026 (sire Pepe, dam Penny), $4,000
- Waitlist open: Pepe x Poppy litter, 2 red girls, born Oct 20, 2026
- Application, then personal review, then deposit; written contract and health guarantee
